{{wikipedia|George Clinton (musician)}}
'''The Funktipus''' is a radio personality in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] on [[Bounce FM]]. Unlike his fellow DJ/[[pimp]] [[Johnny Parkinson|Johnny "The Love Giant" Parkinson]], he doesn't live with his parents and he can actually obtain the girls. Like his voice-over actor George Clinton, the Funktipus is African-American and is a believer in classic funk. His song "Loopzilla" is featured on Bounce FM's playlist.
